# stacklet_iac_policy_collection (Data Source)

Fetch a Stacklet IaC policy collection, a set of IaC policies to evaluate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch an IaC policy collection by name
data "stacklet_iac_policy_collection" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the policy collection.

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the collection is a default, applied to projects that have no policy collections assigned.
- `is_mirror` (Boolean) Whether the collection mirrors the policies of a policy source.
- `policies` (Set of String) The names of policies in the collection.
